name: sprint-planning
description: Sprint planning demo. User pastes 'meeting notes' via the suggestion chip; the agent (a) renders an animated 'attached' file card for the notes via attachMeetingNotes, then (b) proposes the headline pull-in (ISS-113 GDPR) via propose_issue_change so the user can accept/edit/reject. Follow-up 'what else' adds the search-pagination fix.
